temporal.yaml
```
log:
  stdout: true
  level: "info"

persistence:
  defaultStore: default
  visibilityStore: visibility
  numHistoryShards: 512
  datastores:
    default:
      sql:
        pluginName: "mysql8"
        driverName: "mysql8"
        databaseName: "temporal"
        connectAddr: "192.168.6.100:3306"
        connectProtocol: "tcp"
        user: temporal
        password: {{ .Env.TEMPORAL_STORE_PASSWORD | quote }}
        maxConnLifetime: 1h
        maxConns: 100
        maxIdleConns: 25
        secretName: ""
    visibility:
      sql:
        pluginName: "mysql8"
        driverName: "mysql8"
        databaseName: "temporal_visibility"
        connectAddr: "192.168.6.100:3306"
        connectProtocol: "tcp"
        user: "temporal"
        password: {{ .Env.TEMPORAL_VISIBILITY_STORE_PASSWORD  | quote }}
        maxConnLifetime: 1h
        maxConns: 100
        maxIdleConns: 25
        secretName: ""

global:
  membership:
    name: temporal
    maxJoinDuration: 30s
    broadcastAddress: {{ default .Env.POD_IP "0.0.0.0" }}

  pprof:
    port: 7936

  metrics:
    tags:
      type: {{ .Env.SERVICES }}
    prometheus:
      timerType: histogram
      listenAddress: "0.0.0.0:9090"

services:
  frontend:
    rpc:
      grpcPort: 7233
      httpPort: 7243
      membershipPort: 6933
      bindOnIP: "0.0.0.0"

  history:
    rpc:
      grpcPort: 7234
      membershipPort: 6934
      bindOnIP: "0.0.0.0"

  matching:
    rpc:
      grpcPort: 7235
      membershipPort: 6935
      bindOnIP: "0.0.0.0"

  worker:
    rpc:
      membershipPort: 6939
      bindOnIP: "0.0.0.0"

clusterMetadata:
  enableGlobalDomain: false
  failoverVersionIncrement: 10
  masterClusterName: "active"
  currentClusterName: "active"
  clusterInformation:
    active:
      enabled: true
      initialFailoverVersion: 1
      rpcName: "temporal-frontend"
      rpcAddress: "127.0.0.1:7233"
      httpAddress: "127.0.0.1:7243"

dcRedirectionPolicy:
  policy: "noop"
  toDC: ""

archival:
  history:
    enableRead: true
    provider:
      s3store:
        region: us-east-1
    state: enabled
  visibility:
    enableRead: true
    provider:
      s3store:
        region: us-east-1
    state: enabled
namespaceDefaults:
  archival:
    history:
      URI: s3://temporal-archival/manus/history
      state: enabled
    visibility:
      URI: s3://temporal-archival/manus/visibility
      state: enabled
publicClient:
  hostPort: "temporal-frontend:7233"

dynamicConfigClient:
  filepath: "/etc/temporal/dynamic_config/dynamic_config.yaml"
  pollInterval: "10s"
```
